ja: チームリーダーの指摘をもっと早く聞いておけばよかった。そうすれば、発表の前にスライドを直せたのに。
en: I wish I'd listened to my team lead's feedback sooner, because then I could have fixed the slides before the presentation.
alternatives: If only I'd listened to my team lead's feedback earlier; I could have fixed the slides before the presentation.
I should've listened to my team lead's feedback sooner. Then I could've fixed the slides before the presentation.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish I had + 過去分詞

ja: 今回いただいた報告書は、内容が正確なだけでなく、構成も非常に分かりやすかったです。
en: Not only was your report accurate, but it was also remarkably easy to follow.
alternatives: Your report was not only accurate but also really easy to follow.
Your report wasn't just accurate; it was also very easy to follow.
point: Not only を文頭に出したら was your report と語順を倒す
